<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Chainsaw"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Properties" name="Chainsaw properties"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductionUpdate" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Customer feedback on first chainsaw"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Chainsaw manufacturer" processRef="Process_Chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PropertiesToStart" name="Send chainsaw properties"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_PropertiesReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_UpdateToCustomer" name="Production update"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendProductionUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstSawToCustomer" name="Send first chainsaw"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FeedbackToManufacturer" name="Customer feedback"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_CustomerFeedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chainsaw" name="Chainsaw production" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PropertiesReceived" name="Chainsaw properties received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Properties" messageRef="Message_Properties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources in parallel"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionSplit" name="Split production"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PartsArrived" name="Parts arrived"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Manually inspect all parts"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" name="Assemble first chainsaw"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw to customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw" name="Customer likes first chainsaw?"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRemainingSaws" name="Produce remaining chainsaws of order"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RemainingNotProduced" name="Remaining order not produced"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProductionUpdate" name="Send production update to customer" messageRef="Message_ProductionUpdate">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics id="Loop_ProductionUpdates" testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" id="LoopCondition_ProductionInProgress">${productionInProgress}</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UpdatesFinished" name="Production updates finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToSplit" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_PropertiesReceived" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToPartsArrived" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Event_PartsArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_SendProductionUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsArrivedToInspect" sourceRef="Event_PartsArrived" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectToAssemble" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssembleToSendFirstSaw" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirstSaw" targetRef="Task_SendFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendFirstSawToFeedback" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Event_CustomerFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToDecision" sourceRef="Event_CustomerFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LikesYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemainingSaws">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" id="Condition_LikesYes">${customerLikesFirstSaw}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LikesNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw" targetRef="EndEvent_RemainingNotProduced">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" id="Condition_LikesNo">${!customerLikesFirstSaw}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProduceRemainingToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemainingSaws" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdatesToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendProductionUpdate" targetRef="EndEvent_UpdatesFinished"/>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
